purpose: Independent floating-point diagnostic of the root variance-reduction magnitude for the C7 wave-policy updates; this is not a numerical certificate.
equation: d_r y = (1/2) d_xx y + lambda*y + G_q(y)/lambda

boundary_approximation.qualification: Homogeneous-limit domain-truncation approximation, not the exact boundary value at finite x.

determinism: No random sampling, seeds, repetitions, or tuning.
validation: all policies reproduce the prescribed zero-time vector exactly
all approximate moments are finite and nonnegative up to floating tolerance
successive root-moment differences decrease from dx=0.1->0.05 to dx=0.05->0.025 on [-12,12]
failure_rule: Retain results but mark validation failed if any stated invariant fails; do not reinterpret a failure as a theorem counterexample without further analysis.
resource_cap: A few CPU minutes on the prescribed four grids.
excluded_claims: removal of spatial truncation or discretization error
